jobs.title: Security Guard, Substitute
jobs.description:
Job Description

Wage - $20.77 an hour

Schedule – As needed

MTC is proud to operate the Joliet Job Corps Center in Joliet, IL where our staff provide quality services to our local youth. We value our professional and caring employees who are dedicated to improving people’s lives and we want YOU to join our team!

What you will be doing: Responsible for providing security coverage at campus access gate, performing patrol duties in assigned areas to ensure positive group relations and activities, to protect life and property, in compliance with government and management directives.

Essential Functions

  • Follow company security procedures on all persons and vehicles entering and exiting the campus
  • Advise students and provide guidance for positive attitude and behavior in on center activities
  • Patrol and monitor center grounds and the surrounding vicinities as required ensuring safety and proper behavior of students; resolving potential or occurring problems
  • Protect and secure buildings, center vehicles and property by checking doors, windows, lights, electrical appliances, equipment, locks and emergency equipment; maintain log of findings and corrective action taken; control security vehicle assignments and use
  • Assist in emergency evacuation, control and accountability of students and staff; respond to fire alarms; take necessary steps to report fires; reset fire alarm equipment
  • Issue visitor badges and parking permits; issue staff and student keys and badges; maintain related records
  • Distribute petty cash, maintain accountability logs and receipts, and audit each shift
  • Assist staff and law enforcement personnel in controlling disturbances; conduct investigation of crimes and unauthorized activities as assigned
  • Review student problems with counselors and student personnel officer
  • Assume supervisory responsibility of all safety and security activities when assigned
  • Perform administrative functions such as logs, incident reports and accident documentation; act as center dispatcher as assigned
  • When directed to do so, overtime is expected
  • Regular and predictable attendance is required
  • Participate in student employability programs and activities
  • Support and promote center zero tolerance policies
  • Provide positive, quality customer services to students, staff and other center customers
  • Promote the development of Career Success Standards by modeling appropriate behaviors, mentoring students where necessary and monitoring both positive and negative behaviors through interventions
  • Maintain accountability of students and property; adhere to safety practices
  • Assist, support and communicate with community life departments to ensure high level of service.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent and one year experience working with youth preferred
  • Security related experience is desired
  • Computer proficiency required
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record

Management & Training Corporation (MTC) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, disabled status, veteran status, genetic information, national origin, or any other category protected by federal law. MTC participates in E-Verify. We strive to provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities, including disabled veterans, in our job application and hiring process. If you are interested in employment opportunities with Management & Training Corporation and need assistance, please contact our staffing department through customersupport@mtctrains.com or 801-693-2888.

The Shift Security Supervisor will supervise and coordinate the delivery of quality services on a specific shift at an assigned customer. jobs.title: Warehouse Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Warehouse Operations Supervisor

Location: Melrose Park, Illinois, United States , On-site

Employment Type: Full-time

Reports To: Warehouse Manager / Operations Manager


About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on and bilingual Warehouse Operations Supervisor to support and oversee daily warehouse operations. This role will be responsible for coordinating warehouse workflows, resolving operational issues, improving warehouse processes, and ensuring stable, accurate, and efficient execution across inbound, storage, inventory, picking, packing, shipping, and returns.

This position serves as a key bridge between the warehouse operations team, internal technical teams, external vendors, and 3PL partners. The ideal candidate is highly responsible, operationally detail-oriented, bilingual in English and Mandarin, and comfortable working in a fast-paced warehouse environment.


Responsibilities

Warehouse Operations & Team Management

  • Supervise daily warehouse operations, including receiving, put-away, inventory, picking, packing, shipping, and returns.
  • Assign daily tasks, monitor workflow, and ensure operational productivity, accuracy, and timeliness.
  • Lead, coach, and support warehouse associates and team leads in daily execution.
  • Partner with HR and warehouse management to recruit, interview, onboard, and train local warehouse employees based on staffing needs.
  • Monitor team performance, provide timely feedback, and promote a disciplined, accountable, and positive warehouse work environment.

Issue Resolution & Cross-functional Coordination

  • Act as the on-site point of contact for daily operational issues, escalations, and process exceptions.
  • Coordinate with internal operations, IT/system teams, equipment vendors, carriers, and 3PL partners to resolve operational issues.
  • Troubleshoot and follow up on system errors, scanner/PDA issues, label printer problems, equipment malfunctions, and other warehouse exceptions.
  • Track issues through closure and help implement preventive actions to reduce repeat problems.

Inventory, Fulfillment & Accuracy Control

  • Oversee inbound receiving accuracy, documentation verification, system updates, and inventory put-away.
  • Support inventory control, cycle counts, bin location accuracy, and discrepancy investigation.
  • Monitor picking, packing, labeling, and shipping quality to ensure order accuracy and on-time fulfillment.
  • Ensure carrier-specific and platform-specific requirements are followed, including FBA and other shipping/labeling standards when applicable.

5S, Safety & Process Improvement

  • Support 5S management, warehouse layout optimization, and on-site improvement projects.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, efficient, and safe warehouse environment.
  • Enforce company safety policies, warehouse procedures, and OSHA-related safety standards.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and propose practical solutions to improve productivity, accuracy, and workflow efficiency.

Data, KPI & Reporting

  • Track daily and weekly operational KPIs, including productivity, order accuracy, inventory accuracy, receiving progress, shipping performance, and exception rates.
  • Prepare operational reports and communicate key issues, risks, and improvement actions to management.
  • Review 3PL/vendor performance data and billing details when applicable.


Requirements

Basic Requirements

  • Authorized to work legally in the United States
  • Fluent bilingual skills in English and Mandarin are required; must be able to speak, listen, read, and write in both languages
  • Spanish language skills are a strong plus
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Automation, or related fields are preferred

Experience & Skills

  • Minimum 2+ years of warehouse, logistics, fulfillment, or supply chain operations experience
  • At least 1 year of warehouse lead, supervisor, or team management experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of warehouse workflows, including inbound, storage, inventory, picking, packing, shipping, and returns
  • Experience with WMS, scanners/PDA, label printers, warehouse systems, and basic troubleshooting preferred
  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills; ability to work with operational data and reports
  • Experience in e-commerce fulfillment, footwear/apparel, 3PL, or high-volume warehouse operations preferred
  • Forklift certification or forklift operating experience is a plus

Personal Attributes

  • Strong leadership, communication, and coordination skills
  • Hands-on problem solver with a strong sense of ownership
  • Detail-oriented, reliable, and highly responsible
  • Able to work under pressure and respond quickly to operational changes
  • Strong learning ability and willingness to improve warehouse processes
  • Comfortable working on the warehouse floor and communicating with both frontline employees and management teams

Physical & Schedule Requirements

  • Must be able to work on-site in a warehouse environment
  • Must be able to stand, walk, bend, lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 lbs as needed
  • Flexibility to work overtime, weekends, or peak-season schedules based on business needs

Benefits

  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Career growth opportunities within warehouse operations and supply chain

jobs.title: JBC-Rack Loader 3rd Shift
jobs.description:
Summary

Manually loads bread onto conveyors and manages equipment racks while ensuring strict quality control through label verification and shortage reporting. Maintains department hygiene and adheres to all safety protocols to ensure a smooth production flow.

Essential Functions

  • Lifts hot 25-pound loaves of bread from conveyor and places it on the racks.
  • Frequently pushing/pulling of full racks into their correct order.
  • Ensure batch numbers and product code on the labels match.
  • Return any unused label back to the supervisor so that it can be recorded.
  • Performs department Sanitation as needed (Dry cleaning/Wet Washing).
  • Detect any malfunction and report it to the supervisor.
  • Comply with all safety requirements and company policies.
  • Report all shortage to the lead operator.
  • Perform other related duties as needed.

Benefits

  • Medical Insurance
  • Prescription Drug Plan
  • Dental/Vision Insurance
  • Employee Incentive Plan
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Cash Accumulation Plan-401K
  • Life/AD&D Insurance
  • Short- Term/Long-Term Disability
  • Vacation Plan
  • Paid Holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Adoption Assistance Program
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Maternity/Paternity Leave
  • Pet Insurance

Salary

  • Starting at $19.18- $22.57 an hour.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent education, training or experience (GED)
  • The employee will be required to lift and handle objects weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • The employee will regularly lift, bend, push, and pull.
  • Able to communicate well, both verbal and written, also with good mathematical skills.

Work Environment

  • Maintain cleanliness of work areas and equipment; follow proper lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures when required.
  • Follow all safety rules, food safety standards, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), and company policies.
  • Report shortages, inconsistencies, or quality concerns to the lead operator or supervisor.
  • This position operates in warehouse and production environments with exposure to strong aromas, airborne dust particles from ingredients, and industrial machinery. Employees must follow all safety procedures and use the required personal protective equipment (PPE).

jobs.description:
Chicago Role Highlights

At a Glance

  • New Opening: Part-Time Warehouse With Benefits — Part-time Hours Full-time Benefits
  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • Company: UPS
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.
  • Our UPS team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

Rewards

  • Earnings: $21-$23/Hour (approx. $23.1k/Year)
  • Benefits: Flexible scheduling available.
  • Earn extra cash with a stable local employer.

Day-to-Day

  • Apply your your professional skills skills in a flexible Chicago environment.

About UPS & Our Culture

It sounds too good to be true — part-time hours with full-time quality benefits. But at UPS, it has been the reality for decades, and it is one of the primary reasons our part-time workforce has some of the highest retention rates in the logistics industry. Our Part-Time Warehouse positions with benefits are the rare exception in the American labor market — roles where Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision coverage, pension contributions, and paid personal time are available to associates working as few as 17.5 hours per week. When you search for warehouse jobs with benefits near me, nothing else on the market delivers what UPS does at the part-time level.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I took this job because my family needed health insurance and I could not afford individual coverage. UPS's Teamsters medical plan costs me a fraction of what individual insurance costs, covers my entire family, and is genuinely better coverage than what my spouse gets at their full-time job. I work 20 hours a week, I am home by 9:30 AM every morning, and my family's healthcare is completely handled. For anyone searching for warehouse jobs with benefits at part-time hours, UPS is completely in its own league." - Current Part-Time Associate with Benefits, Nashville, TN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Part-Time Warehouse Associate with Benefits, you work a structured 3.5 to 5 hour sort shift inside our package center, performing the core loading, sorting, and unloading functions that keep the UPS delivery network running — and accessing a benefits package that most part-time employers do not even attempt to offer.

  • Core Sort Functions: Execute UPS's standard sort operation tasks — unloading trailers, sorting packages on conveyor systems, and loading delivery vehicles in sequence order — building skill and speed across all three functions over time on a consistent part-time schedule.
  • Benefits Enrollment Navigation: Work with UPS's onboarding team to enroll in Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision benefits, understand your pension accrual schedule, and register for the UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance program within your first weeks on the job.
  • Consistent Schedule Reliability: Maintain consistent attendance across your assigned part-time shift window — the foundation on which your Teamsters union seniority, annual wage progression, and long-term benefits eligibility are all built.

Benefits & Perks

This UPS part-time position includes the full Teamsters union benefits package — medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and eligible dependents, a defined-benefit pension plan, paid personal days, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance covering up to $25,000 in education costs. Weekly paychecks and contractual annual wage progression raises complete a benefits offering that no comparable part-time warehouse job with benefits in this market can match.
